title: Pablo Escobar's Hippos Are Still Alive. Colombia Approved Killing Over 80.
description:
In 1981 Pablo Escobar imported four hippos for his private zoo. After his death in 1993 they escaped and spread. By April 2026 there were around 200, and Colombia's Ministry of Environment approved the euthanasia of more than 80 of them, while an Indian billionaire offered to take the animals to India. Most conservationists call them invasive; some ecologists say they should stay. Facts from Wikipedia's article on hippopotamuses in Colombia; pictures from Wikimedia Commons with credits in the video.
